title: Redistributor Token
tagline: The Redistribution Token is about 100% decentralisation and community-driven motion in tokenomics.
description: Instead of calling things right opposite of their essance, I have decided to create right opposite of what we have in fact, and here it is - the most decentralised token ever, where not a single entity controls any process. Redistributor token can be totally isolated from the existing trading models but another type can be directly integrated and serve as a step of evolution for them. And every type has 1000 of scenarios. As on teretto.live we have the isolated versions testing already launched, in terms of this hackathon I am gonna create and test a model which will make better the existing trading models.
how_its_made: The Ethereum blockchain itself is a greate instrument to make things better. The technicall part of the Redistribution Token is based on ERC777 standard (or similar) which allows the contracts to be aware when they receive tokens as it is in case of native tokens, and it took me very long time to find this contracts, because they have been deleted from OpenZeppelin repository, after that I have found only several videos on YouTube about implementation of this ERC777 contracts, and to my pity they are not ideal, but as long as it works it is ok. In the future when big masses see that it is really profitable for them, I hope and the contracts will get better and even new ethereum side-chains can be created redistributor tokens needs.
